description: This frame captures the introductory slide of a Bengali physics lecture. The video features a male instructor standing in front of a whiteboard. The primary visual content is the lecture title written at the top center in Bengali script. The title reads: 'উত্তল দর্পণে রশ্মিচিত্র/প্রতিবিম্ব' (Uttal Darpon-e Rashmichitra/Protibimbo), which translates to 'Ray diagram/Image in a Convex Mirror'. The title is underlined by a thin red line. In the top right corner, the channel or institution logo/watermark 'AMADER SCHOOL' is visible. The purpose of this visual is to clearly state the topic of the lesson: the principles of image formation and ray tracing for convex spherical mirrors.
